assertions.name: covariance_epic_dim_threshold_unifies_A1_A5
assertions.source: Σ dim²·ω₃=0 (closed) but Σ dim³·ω₃=cov≠0 (non-holonomic), all n≤12 — the dim²→dim³ threshold. A1 (exact eval) and A5 (genus) both fail here; the extra dim factor is non-shifted-symmetric. A1 eliminated (route #12). No fit; no c_k.

description: The unifying obstruction of the covariance kernel (qou-x631): A1 (exact evaluation) and A5 (genus expansion) both die at the SAME dim²→dim³ threshold. Verified: Σ_λ (dim)²·ω₃ = 0 exactly (n≤12; the Plancherel expectation of the positive-degree shifted-symmetric ω₃, IO Prop 5.1 — CLOSED), while Σ_λ (dim)³·ω₃ = cov(n) ≠ 0 carries one extra dim factor (=χ^λ(e), not shifted-symmetric) and is NON-HOLONOMIC; even the envelope Σ dim³ = 10,64,596,8056,… has no closed form. Every framework handles dim²-weighted shifted-symmetric averages but not the extra dim: A1 (closed form) → non-holonomic; A5 (genus) → dim∉A, no genus; A2 leading term → ln dim ∉ A. The one missing tool is an expansion of a non-shifted-symmetric dimension functional (dim or ln dim) against Plancherel (Vershik-Kerov ln-dim / Schur-measure / hook-content), NOT the character machinery. This sharply characterizes the open kernel. (Correction: the A1 agent's k=1 row Σ dim·ω₃ is nonzero = |C3|Σχ(σ₃), not 0; the load-bearing k=2/k=3 facts are correct.) A1 ELIMINATED (route #12). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
